title: Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi (Theme 3: Mavazi)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names each part used for typing (kibodi, kipanya, skrini, kitengo kikuu) and says its job.
representations: a real computer with Kiswahili labels
part and job cards to match

board.say: Jina lake ni nini na kazi yake ni ipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child labels the four parts on a drawing and matches each to its job.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Tunatumia ___ kupigia herufi na nambari." Kwa nini "kipanya" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kibodi ina vitufe vya herufi na nambari. Kipanya husogeza kielekezi. Skrini huonyesha. Kichapishi huchapisha.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Skrini hufanya nini?" Kwa nini "Huchapisha kwenye karatasi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kila sehemu ya tarakilishi ina kazi yake: skrini huonyesha, kichapishi huchapisha kwenye karatasi.
Kitengo kikuu ndicho hufanya kazi; skrini huonyesha tu.

misconceptions.ask: Jina la Kiswahili la sehemu hii ni lipi?
misconceptions.repair: Kwa Kiswahili: kibodi, kipanya, skrini, kitengo kikuu.

skills.key_step: The child reads the sentence, decides what kind it is (statement, question, feeling) and gives it a capital at the start and the right mark at the end, with commas in a list.
steps: Is it a statement, question or feeling?
Capital at the start, mark at the end.
Commas between things in a list.

board.do: Point at the first and last word.
board.say: Sentensi hii ni swali? Inahitaji nini?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Je, utavaa sare kesho?" and one more sentence with a list.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi sahihi." Kwa nini "unaenda wapi?" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Sentensi huanza kwa herufi kubwa, na majina ya pekee pia: Wanjiru, Nairobi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi sahihi." Kwa nini "Unaenda wapi." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Sentensi ya swali huisha kwa kiulizi (?). Sentensi ya kawaida huisha kwa kikomo (.).

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi sahihi." Kwa nini "Nilinunua maembe machungwa na ndizi." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Koma hutenganisha vitu katika orodha: maembe, machungwa na ndizi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi sahihi." Kwa nini "Hongera?" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Alama ya hisi (!) huonyesha hisia kama furaha au mshangao: Hongera! Kiulizi (?) huuliza.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Chagua sentensi sahihi." Kwa nini "Wanjiru alienda Mombasa jana" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kila sentensi huisha kwa alama: kikomo (.), kiulizi (?) au alama ya hisi (!).

checks.question: Andika vizuri: nimenunua shati kaptula na soksi

skills.key_step: The child follows the order: switch on, open the program, type with spaces and Shift for capitals, save with a clear name, shut down from the menu.

floor.prerequisite: Names the keyboard, mouse and screen.
floor.question: Tunaandikia kwa kifaa gani?

representations: step cards for the whole task
a keyboard with four keys labelled
a real computer in the lab
steps: Switch on and open the program.
contexts: a typing task at a cyber

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child types "Sare yangu ni safi." with a capital and saves it as "Mavazi - jina".

misconceptions.ask: Kazi yako itakuwa wapi ukichomoa waya?
misconceptions.repair: Hifadhi kazi kwanza, kisha zima tarakilishi kupitia menyu.
Hifadhi kazi kwa jina linaloeleza kilicho ndani.
Enter huanzisha mstari mpya; nafasi hutenganisha maneno.

listen_for: washa Caps Lock na uandike sentensi yote
misconceptions.ask: Sentensi yako yote imekuwa ya herufi kubwa?
misconceptions.repair: Tumia Shift kwa herufi kubwa moja; Caps Lock hufanya herufi zote kuwa kubwa.

checks.question: Ni hatua ipi huja kabla ya kuzima tarakilishi?
Kitufe kipi hufuta herufi ya mwisho?
